instruments.title_en: Madhya Pradesh State Legal Services Authority Rules, 1996
instruments.notes: Original text: MP Gazette (Extraordinary) dt 24 June 1996, pp.522(1)-522(13), signed A. K. Awasthi, Addl. Secy. r.20 (p.522(13)) sets the income limit at Rs. 12,000/- 'or such higher amount as may be notified by the State Government from time to time' and refers to clause (b) of s.12 (now numbered differently in the LSA Act; to confirm). Later amendments not yet in the corpus (G13). Parent: Legal Services Authorities Act 1987 (not yet in manifest).
